it as follows. In the urban dialect survey,
informants were asked to take part in a 'self-evaluation' test
in order to investigate what they believed themselves to be
opposed to what they actually did say. In this test,
they read aloud to the informants with two or more different
variants. For example:
how 1. [hjuːn] 2. [hjuːn]
The first variant has a y-glide [j], the second 'h-less'.
Both pronunciations are current in Norwich, the home
of the RP pronunciation, having more prestige than the
informants were then asked to say, by marking a
chart, which of the pronunciations they normally
uses. By comparing the results of this test with the
tape-recorded during the interviews, it became possible
to discover discrepancies between what informants say
they say and what they actually said. The results for the
social classes, which we will see were very interesting, and not
always straightforward, are divided into two groups.
The informants tended to be very consistent in their tape-recorded
speech, but they were not when they were self-assessing. They
varied their self-assessment, some choosing the y-glide ones, and those with less formal
class background tended to be more open. They were honest about it.

Purpose of Game: 
Best played for fun - a good strenuous game. 

Description of Game: Each team plants a flag in a vis-  ible but inconspicuous spot in their territory. They  must stay at least 5 meters away from their flag unless in  pursuit of an opponent. 

Each team is to try to find and capture their opponent's
flag - while defending, by capturing opponents who
are trying to take their flag. The winner is the team
which captures the flag and returns it to its home base.
If time expires before this is done, the winner is the
team that captured more of their opponents.


Capturing - players have a strip of wool on their right
arm. If this is captured by an opponent, they can return
to home base and, after a 2 - minute penalty, get a new
ribbon.


Variation: Players can be captured with a 2-hand touch. The prisoner must go to a jail defined by her captors. She can then be freed by a member of her own team who touches her. Several captured players can be freed at once if they are holding hand.

Creamy Garlic & Roasted Red Pepper Pasta
PREP TIME: 15 MINUTES | 4 SERVINGS
12 oz pasta (penne or fusilli)
2 tbsp olive oil
3 cloves garlic, minced
1 cup roasted red peppers, chopped
1/2 cup heavy cream
1/4 cup grated Parmesan cheese
Salt
Pepper
Red pepper flakes
Fresh parsley
to taste
1. Bring a large pot of salted water to a boil. Add the pasta and cook according to package instructions until al dente. Drain, reserving 1/4 cup of the pasta water.
2. Meanwhile, heat the olive oil in a large skillet over medium heat. Add the garlic and cook until fragrant, about 1 minute.
3. Stir in the roasted red peppers and cook for 2 minutes. Pour in the heavy cream and bring to a simmer.
4. Add the Parmesan cheese and stir until melted and the sauce has thickened slightly.
5. Add the cooked pasta to the skillet and toss to coat with the sauce. If the sauce is too thick, add the reserved pasta water, a tablespoon at a time, until desired consistency is reached.
6. Season with salt, pepper, and red pepper flakes to taste. Garnish with fresh parsley before serving.
Enjoy this creamy and flavorful pasta dish as a quick weeknight dinner or a simple yet elegant meal for guests.
For an extra kick, add some crushed red pepper flakes or serve with a side of crusty bread to soak up the sauce.
Enjoy!

100g (3½oz) plain flour
1 tsp baking powder
1 tsp ground cinnamon
1 tsp ground ginger
½ tsp ground cloves
¼ tsp freshly grated nutmeg
100g (3½oz) unsalted butter, softened
100g (3½oz) light muscovado sugar
100g (3½oz) black treacle
1 large egg, beaten
1 tbsp milk
100g (3½oz) icing sugar, sifted
1 tbsp lemon juice
a little green food colouring
red and green candied cherries, to decorate
Preheat the oven to 180°C/350°F/gas 4.
Grease and base-line a 1lb loaf tin.
Sift the flour, baking powder and spices into a bowl.
Cream the butter and sugar together until light and fluffy.
Gradually beat in the treacle, egg and milk.
Fold in the flour mixture.
Spoon into the tin and level the top.
Bake for 40-45 minutes, or until a skewer inserted into the centre comes out clean.
Leave to cool in the tin for 5 minutes, then turn out onto a wire rack to cool completely.

VizWiz_val_00000300.jpg: # BEAT THE BURGLAR BASIC TIPS: When you go out, always lock the door and close the windows even if you are just going out for a short time. Window locks, especially on older windows, will help stop people getting in (and remember, a burglar is less likely to break in if they have to smash a window). If you have deadlocks, use them. They make it harder for a thief to get out again. But don't leave the key near the door, or in an obvious place. - Don't leave spare keys outside, or in a garage or shed, and put car keys or garage keys out of sight in the house. - Use timers for lights and radios if you need to be away from home overnight. They will create the impression that someone is in. Visible burglar alarms, good lighting, and carefully directed and limited security lighting can act as deterrents. But make sure that lights don't disturb your neighbours, and that alarms turn off after 20 minutes. Fences at the back of the house may make this area more secure, but walls and solid fencing may let a thief break in without being seen. A good compromise is chain-link fencing, or trellises with prickly shrubs. • Fitting a 'spy hole' allows you to see who is at the door. Having a door chain means you can open the door a little way to talk. safely. Make sure that any improvements you make don't stop you from getting out of your house as quickly as possible if there is a fire.

Blio, libros para todos.
Una compañía cuyo propósito es proveer acceso a la letra impresa a las personas ciegas.
En la década de los 2000's KNFB Reading Technology introdujo el KNFB Reader. Un equipo, el cual
luego se combinará con un teléfono celular, que te permite tomar una foto a un documento impreso, y este te
lee en voz alta o te lo traduce a Braille electrónico.


Basandose en el exito del KNFB Reader, KNFB Reading Technology decidio intentar algo distinto. El
proveer acceso a los libros electronicos. De eso salio Blio. Como iBooks, funciona hambo de tienda y como lector.
Blio provee acceso a libros electronicos en casi todas las plataformas tecnologicas.


Al principio Blio fue criticado por que no era accesible para las personas ciegas. Pero esto fue rectificado
Blio tiene aplicaciones para el iPhone, el iPad y
apidamente. Ademas de proveer acceso via lectores de pantallas.
os telefonos Android. Asi que los estudiantes pueden cargar los libros, no importa el equipo que utilizen.


Blio en la computadora funciona igual a iBooks en el iPad. Blio te permite engresar parrafos o frases, te
permite tomar notas en el libro, buscar definiciones y verificar el como se escribe una palabra. En la version
mobil, Blio es un poco mas limitado, por ejemplo, no puedes tomar notas, pero el hecho que puedas tener el libro
no importa el equipo que estes utilizando, lo hace mas atractivo para escuelas que no tengan el dinero para
comprar iPads o ya ayan comprado otros equipos y no quieran reinvertir en otros equipos. Al momento de esta
escritura, Blio esta disponible en las siguientes plataformas: Windows XP, Vista, 7 y 8, iPhone, iPod touch, y
Pad, y muchos telefonos y tabletas Android. Todavia no existe una version para la Mac.


No sin embargo, no es el unico que puede ser utilizado en multiples plataformas. Existen otros programas

For instance, OCR programs require users to carefully center the text they want to read in the cam- era's view, and then return all of the text. In contrast, VizWiz users can simply ask what they really want to know, for in- stance, "How much is the cheeseburger?" Because blind peo- ple cannot see the picture they are taking, pictures are often not framed well or have other problems. Real people can give guidance as to how to take a better picture. With real people answering questions, we can first target tools to what blind people want and then try to automate, rather than create tools according to what can currently be done automatically and hope they are good enough. # Contributions Our contributions are the following - We motivate and present VizWiz, a talking mobile applica- tion that lets blind people take a picture, ask a question, and receive answers from remote workers in nearly real-time. - We introduce *quikTurkit*, an approach and accompanying implementation that shows how workers can be intelligently recruited in advance to reduce latency. - We show that VizWiz can work in real-world situations and we demonstrate some of the primary problems that blind people have taking photographs in a field deployment - We introduce VizWiz::LocateIt, a VizWiz extension that combines remote human-powered vision with automatic computer vision, illustrating how VizWiz facilitates par- ticipatory design with prototype tools which cannot yet be made fully automatic. **MOTIVATING SURVEY** We first recruited 11 participants (5 female) to get an idea of how blind people might want to use a system like VizWiz. We presented the idea of VizWiz, and asked participants how they could imagine using it. Participants wanted to read text in a variety of situations - road signs, cafe menu boards, tags on clothes, and cooking instructions on a packaged meal. Several participants wanted information about their physical appearance. For instance, how does this outfit look or is this shirt stained or discoloured? Many participants just wanted feedback on how good the picture was that they took or gen- eral information on the photos they have taken. Google's An- droid platform and the Apple iPhone 3GS now include free screen readers [36, 6]. The iPhone has proven particularly popular among blind users, which motivated us to concen- trate on it for VizWiz. Apple's stringent controls on the ap- plications available on its online store and tighter integration of its screen reader (VoiceOver) with the operating system has resulted in a large number of accessible applications. Touchscreen devices like the iPhone were once assumed to be inaccessible to blind users, but well-designed, multitouch interfaces leverage the spatial layout of the screen and can even be preferred by blind people [12]. Applications for general-purpose smartphones are beginning to replace special-purpose devices, but blind people still carry devices such as GPS powered navigation aids, barcode read- ers, light detectors, color identifiers, and compasses [13]. Some accessible applications that use the camera on existing phones include currency reading applications and color iden- tifiers [20, 37]. Because VizWiz connects users to real peo- ple, it can potentially answer all of the questions answerable by many costly special-purpose applications and devices. *Talking OCR Devices*: Of particular interest to blind people is the ability to read text, which pervasively labels objects and provides information. Both the KNFBReader [16] and the Intel Reader [11] are talking mobile OCR tools. VizWiz has an advantage over tools such as these because humans can still read more text written in more variations than can automatic approaches. When OCR works, however, it is faster and can be used to transcribe large text passages. Hu- man workers are slower but this may be partially offset by their ability to take instructions that require intelligence. For example, an OCR program can read an entire menu, but can- not be asked, "What is the price of the cheapest salad?" *Other Automatic Computer Vision for Mobile Devices: Sev- eral research projects and products expose automatic com- puter vision on mobile devices. 美食的黄金守则 在追求美食的道路上,有几条黄金守则 能让我们不仅吃得开心,更能吃出健康。 这些守则不仅适用于家庭烹饪,也适用于 在外就餐的选择。遵循这些原则,让饮食 成为一种享受。 一、食材新鲜是基础 食材的质量直接决定了菜肴的口感和营养 价值。新鲜的蔬菜、水果、肉类和海鲜,不仅 口感鲜美,且含有更丰富的营养成分。尽量 选择当季食材,不仅价格更亲民,且品质 往往也是最好的。避免购买过度加工的食 品,减少添加剂的摄入。 二、均衡饮食是核心 没有一种食物能提供人体所需的所有营养 素。因此,食物的多样性至关重要。每餐 都应包含碳水化合物、蛋白质、脂肪、维生 素和矿物质。通过搭配不同颜色的蔬果和 谷物,可以确保摄入全面的营养。 三、烹饪方式要讲究 健康的烹饪方式可以最大程度地保留食材 的营养,减少有害物质的产生。推荐使用 蒸、煮、炖、拌等方式,减少油炸、烧烤和 过度煎炒。这不仅能减少油脂的摄入,还 能避免因高温烹饪产生的致癌物质。 四、适量摄入是关键 即使是再健康的食物,过量食用也会对身 体造成负担。学会控制食量,吃到七八分饱 即可。这有助于减轻肠胃负担,防止肥胖 及相关慢性疾病的发生。 五、享受过程更重要 美食不仅是为了填饱肚子,更是一种生活 的艺术。在用餐时,放下手机和工作的烦 恼,专注于食物的味道、香气和质感。细嚼 慢咽,不仅有助于消化,更能让你从每一 口食物中感受到幸福。 六、水分补充不可少 水是生命之源,参与体内的新陈代谢。保 持充足的水分摄入,有助于皮肤健康和身 体功能的正常运转。尽量选择白开水或淡 茶,少喝含糖饮料,这能有效减少热量摄 入。 遵循这些黄金守则,不仅能让你在享受美 食的同时,也能守护好自己的健康。让每 一次进餐,都成为对自己身体的呵护。 从今天开始,尝试做出一点改变吧。 [VISUAL_TEXT] [VISUAL_TEXT] [VISUAL_TEXT] 备注: 健康饮食 对于特定人群(如糖尿病患者、高血压患 者等),饮食应更加谨慎。建议咨询专业 医生或营养师,根据个人的身体状况,制定 个性化的饮食方案。不要盲目跟风所谓的 “超级食物”或极端饮食法。 结语: 美食是生活的调味剂,健康的身体则是生 活的基石。在美食与健康之间找到平衡, 这才是真正的生活智慧。愿你既能品尝世 间美味,又能拥有强健体魄,享受美好生 活。 保持良好的心态,也是健康生活的一部分。 让我们一起,为了健康和美味而努力。 享受每一餐,享受生活。 香港麥當勞食品之營養資料 Nutritional Information of Selected Menu Items in Hong Kong 食品名稱 (Food Item) 能量 (Energy) (kcal) 蛋白質 (Protein) (g) 總脂肪 (Total Fat) (g) 漢堡包 (Hamburger) 芝士漢堡包 (Cheeseburger) 雙層芝士漢堡包 (Double Cheeseburger)

Free
Wish you had someone handy to tell you what
something was or to clarify something any time of the
day or night? VizWiz is an amazing application that is
extremely effective. Simply take a picture of any object
and record your question. Then select whom you wish to send it to. Your
choices are Web Worker, IQ Engine, email or Twitter. Web worker is a
human volunteer who will review and answer your question. In testing we
took a photo of a bottle of foundation makeup. We then asked "Is there any
sunscreen in this foundation?" In less than 30 seconds we received an
accurate answer from a Web Worker "Yes, the foundation has 15 SPF
sunscreen. Another choice for response is IQ Engine, a character reader.
The response from the IQ Engine was to recite the product UPC code. While
the IQ Engine was not accurate, we do see where it could be handy for
getting serial numbers or other numerical data. Email allows you to send
your question to someone you know from your contacts and Twitter will
tweet your question to your followers. We were impressed by VizWiz, and
did we mention it is free?
